preserve: All original literal, declaration, block, tag, JSON-value, JSON-token, native-type, line and module-load readers.

banned_substitutions: Do not weaken a refusal, omit a source root, narrow an assertion or add a blanket test exemption.
Do not create a second rendering or UI owner.
Do not author or execute the archived old source in its read-only evidence home.
